_comment: The mode registry. Every NeuronScope surface renders its tabs from this file, so a new mode is an entry here rather than a code change in four frontends. `surfaces` lists which frontends implement a mode; one that does not yet implement it shows the tab disabled rather than hiding it, so the navigation is the same everywhere and a missing feature is visible instead of silent.

modes.label: Run
modes.summary: Pipeline state, stage launching, live logs.

modes.summary: Load a model and talk to it; suppression and expert dials.

modes.summary: Two models or two profiles, side by side.
